headline: Discussed detached accessory dwelling units and requested a draft regulation
summary: The commission reviewed other towns' regulations on detached accessory dwelling units (ADUs). The commission asked staff to prepare a draft regulation for detached ADUs. No formal decision was recorded on the ADU regulations themselves.
plain_text:
P&Z – 3-29-2023  1 
 
Wallingford Planning and Zoning Commission 
Special Meeting – Workshop Format 
Monday, October 05, 2026 
6:00 p.m. 
Wallingford Library, Charlotte Collins Room 
 
 
Chairman Fitzsimms called the meeting to order at approximately 6:04 p.m. 
Pledge of Allegiance was recited by all. 
Roll Call:  Present: James Fitzsimmons, Chairman, Jeff Kohan, Vice Chairman, Dave Leonardo, Secretary, 
J.P. Venoit, Regular Member; James Seichter, Regular Member; Joe Sanders, Alternate; Casey Camire, 
Alternate; Richard Benham, Alternate. 
Staff:  Kevin Pagini, Town Planner 
                         
 DISCUSSION 
 
A discussion was held regarding detached ADUs and the Commission reviewed information regarding 
other Town’s regulations.  The Commission has asked for a draft for detached ADU’s.    
 
 
Chairman Fitzsimmons: Motion to adjourn the October 5, 2026, Planning and Zoning Commission 
Special Meeting at 7:37 pm. 
Commissioner Kohan: Second 
Vote: Unanimous to approve
